newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power lifts off-peak, firm price $1/MWh.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power lifts off-peak, firm price $1/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) raised its next-day offer price for firm sales during off-peak hours of 0100-0500 PDT to $14.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) from $13.00 for Tuesday pre-schedulings, the agency said Tuesday.
Prices for peak-hour sales between 0800 and 2100 PDT were unchanged at $20.00 per MWh ($19.00 non-firm), with firm sales still limited to 200 MW.
Shoulder hour prices were split between $16.00 for hours ending 0600 and 2400 ($15.00 non-firm) and $18.00 for hours ending 0700, 2200 and 2300 ($17.00 non-firm).
BPA also placed a volume limit of 500 MW was also placed on non-firm sales during offpeak hours.
